Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 10B pages × ~2 MB (worst-case transfer) in 5 days; one 200 Gbps instance ≈ 12.5k pages/s theoretical, ~30% usable = 3,750/s → ~31 days alone → 8 machines ≈ 3.9 days

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Per-domain limit is ~1 req/s but millions of domains are crawled in parallel, so aggregate throughput is high. DNS can dominate time: cache lookups, use several DNS providers

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Extras: headless browser for JS pages, HEAD request to skip huge files, URL scheduler for recrawls, priority queues
